documentation.file_docstring:
CI check: ensure core packages have no unguarded vendor imports.

Scans agent_os/ and agentmesh/ core source directories for imports from
vendor frameworks (langchain, openai, anthropic, etc.) that are NOT inside
a try/except block. Exits non-zero if any are found.

Usage:
    python scripts/check_vendor_imports.py
header_comments: Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. Licensed under the MIT License.
inline_comments: Directories where vendor imports are expected (adapters, integrations)
member_docstrings: is_vendor_import: Return the vendor module name if this is a vendor import, else None.
is_inside_try: Check if a node is inside a try/except block.
is_in_allowed_dir: Check if file is in an integrations/adapters directory.
check_file: Check a single Python file for unguarded vendor imports.
